findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_expert" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_states, get_levels_of_care, list_browse_categories, list_facility_types · Private data: get_expert · Public sink: search_facilities, search_experts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_states, get_levels_of_care, list_browse_categories, list_facility_types · Private data: get_expert · Public sink: search_facilities, search_experts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
